tools.name: search_filings
tools.description: Full-text search across SEC filings since 2001 (EDGAR FTS). Supports quoted phrases ("share repurchase"), boolean OR, and filters for form types, date range and company CIKs. Returns matching filings with company, form, filing date, 8-K items and a document URL. Default range: last 365 days.

tools.name: resolve_company
tools.description: Convert a stock ticker to its SEC CIK and company name, or a CIK to its ticker and name. Use it to get the CIK needed by search_filings.

findings.title: Lethal trifecta: untrusted input + private data + external sink
findings.detail: Server "mcp" exposes tools that together enable an exfiltration flow. Untrusted content: get_company_filings, search_filings · Private data: get_company_filings, search_filings · Public sink: search_filings.

evidence.snippet: Untrusted content: get_company_filings, search_filings · Private data: get_company_filings, search_filings · Public sink: search_filings

findings.remediation: Do not co-install these capabilities under one trust boundary; an injected comment/email can steer the model to exfiltrate via the sink tool.
